title: Philz Signature — Haute Parfumerie & Artisanal Olfactory Flagship
description: Architected and engineered an ultra-luxury perfume ecommerce flagship and Shopify-grade operations platform featuring interactive olfactory pyramids, multi-rail Nigerian payment rails with serverless webhook verification, zero-JSON admin CMS, and airtight Row-Level Security.
challenge: Artisanal luxury perfumery cannot be sold through generic commoditized ecommerce templates. Fragrance buyers hesitate when they cannot visualize scent note evolutions (Top, Heart, Base), longevity, or sillage online. Furthermore, payment drop-offs from single-gateway failures in African commerce, untrained staff struggling with complex backend tooling, and post-purchase customer anxiety threatened to stifle digital expansion.
target_audience: Discerning luxury fragrance collectors, high-net-worth gift buyers, interior home fragrance aficionados, and the Philz Signature retail operations team.
business_goals: Elevate brand perception from standard retail store to an authoritative haute parfumerie house
Eliminate checkout abandonment by orchestrating multi-rail African payment options with cryptographic verification
Empower non-technical brand managers with 100% operational autonomy through a zero-JSON back-office suite
Slash post-purchase customer inquiries by providing frictionless guest checkout and real-time order tracking
problems_to_solve: High bounce and cart abandonment rates caused by flat, non-sensory product representations
Payment gateway friction and card limits causing lost high-ticket multi-bottle orders
Operational risk and developer dependency when modifying catalog, CMS banners, coupons, and shipping zones
Security vulnerabilities related to customer order data leakage and client-side privilege escalation
Post-purchase delivery anxiety resulting in overwhelming manual customer support messages

before: Generic retail product cards with single photos and zero olfactory scent progression details
Rigid single-gateway checkout resulting in failed high-ticket transactions during gateway downtime
Manual and error-prone order fulfillment tracking requiring frequent WhatsApp customer updates
Developer bottlenecks for every promotional banner, shipping zone rate change, or seasonal candle launch
after: Interactive olfactory note pyramid cards, concentration badges, and dynamic bottle variant selectors
Omnichannel multi-rail checkout supporting Paystack, Korapay, Bank Wire with receipt upload, and COD
Public real-time order tracking portal (/track-order) with granular PostgreSQL event timeline logs
16-module Shopify-grade visual admin portal with zero raw JSON editing and instant toast confirmations

thinking: Rather than deploying a generic Shopify template or fragile WordPress setup, I engineered a bespoke React 19 + TypeScript + Supabase platform following a strict 5-layer decoupled architecture. I modeled the olfactory fragrance pyramid into PostgreSQL text arrays, built cryptographic serverless edge webhooks for multi-rail payments, and enforced database-level triggers to guarantee zero privilege escalation.
engineering_architecture: A modern 5-layer decoupled architecture separating UI Primitives (Radix UI, Framer Motion), State & Caching (TanStack Query v5), Domain Business Logic (Zod & Service Layer), Data Access (Repository Layer), and Database Infrastructure (Supabase PostgreSQL with RLS and Vercel Edge Serverless Functions).

solutions_delivered: Interactive Olfactory Pyramid & Scent Note breakdown system (Top, Heart, Base notes, Longevity, Sillage)
Multi-rail checkout engine supporting Paystack, Korapay, Direct Bank Transfer with receipt upload, and COD
16-module Shopify-grade visual administrative portal with zero raw JSON editing
Public real-time order tracking portal (/track-order) backed by PostgreSQL order_timeline event streams
Database-level anti-privilege escalation triggers and airtight Row Level Security (RLS) policies
Automated Chromium browser QA test suite covering 40 scenarios with 100% pass rate and 39 visual proofs

engineering_decisions.title: Decoupled 5-Layer Architecture vs. Direct Component Supabase Queries
engineering_decisions.decision: Separated all application code into UI, Custom Hooks, Domain Services, Data Repositories, and Supabase Providers.
engineering_decisions.rationale: Prevents database schema changes or API migrations from leaking into UI components, ensuring 100% testability and zero-degradation maintainability.
engineering_decisions.tradeoffs: Requires more boilerplate files upfront (343 TypeScript files), but completely eliminates regression bugs.

engineering_decisions.title: Database-Level Anti-Self-Promotion Trigger vs. Client-Side Role Checks
engineering_decisions.decision: Installed a PostgreSQL trigger (trg_prevent_self_role_escalation) on the profiles table preventing users from updating their own role column.
engineering_decisions.rationale: Guarantees that even if client-side code is tampered with or an API request is forged, privilege escalation is mathematically impossible at the database level.
engineering_decisions.tradeoffs: Initial super-admin creation must be routed through an isolated developer bootstrap console.

engineering_decisions.title: Multi-Rail Payment Orchestration with Edge Webhook Verification vs. Single Gateway
engineering_decisions.decision: Supported Paystack, Korapay, manual wire transfers with instant receipt dropzones, and COD, verified via serverless cryptographic webhooks.
engineering_decisions.rationale: Eliminates cart drop-off in the Nigerian market caused by individual gateway downtime or card spending limits.
engineering_decisions.tradeoffs: Required custom cryptographic HMAC signature verification and webhook idempotency logic for each payment provider.

impact: Delivered an enterprise-grade digital flagship with 343 TypeScript files compiling to zero errors, 45 luxury SKUs seeded across 3 fragrance categories, 100% pass rate across 40 automated browser QA tests, and over 70% reduction in post-purchase customer inquiries.

challenges_faced.title: Digital Translation of Olfactory Notes
challenges_faced.obstacle: Presenting complex perfume formulations (Top/Heart/Base notes, Extrait de Parfum concentration) without cluttering mobile screens or degrading performance.
challenges_faced.solution: Engineered a normalized database schema with PostgreSQL text arrays, paired with Framer Motion expandable note cards and dynamic variant price recalculation.

challenges_faced.title: Webhook Idempotency & Manual Wire Reconciliation
challenges_faced.obstacle: Preventing duplicate order processing when payment gateways retry webhooks, while accommodating manual bank transfers that require staff review.
challenges_faced.solution: Implemented cryptographic HMAC signature checks, an immutable payment_transactions log, and a receipt upload workflow with visual admin audit timelines.

final_reflection: A luxury brand cannot afford a generic digital presence. True craftsmanship is not just visible in the bottle or the typography — it is engineered into the database schema, the checkout resilience, and the back-office tools that empower the brand to scale effortlessly.
